Builder C4 (research/ws_chem_c4.md): the replaced wired loaders use TWO POOL-FREE 38-PRODUCT GROUPS: two
disjoint 6-output groups (outputs in the wire basis) each planned at 38 products by an exact search (every
hyperplane of the group's relation space, priced by Lovasz's randomized matroid-parity rank, public
mathematics), every product non-silent on the next group's kill coordinate; groups 3 and 4 by the production
engine (designer R59's TieKill over builder C2's placed-kill engine and C-4 closure), group 3 at 42 by
builder C2's annealer; emitted and checked by builder C2's emit_c4. Tools: chem_c4_dump.py, chem_c4_wb.py,
chem_c4_ns.py, chem_c4_pair.py, chem_c4_pre.py, chem_c4_build.py, tools/sh/chem_c4_loader.sh. Base entry: <HOME>/qcc/ws/chem_c4/best/c4_pB1q9

  rebuilt from Lera / marculera's public Apache-2.0 pipeline (marculera/dfthc-compact-pipeline; research/
  ws_chem_factor.md), and public loader notebooks (Lera, maoxin) were read for the engine's early ideas. The
  objective and file format are the hosts' starter kit's. The table, its labels, rounding, finishing chain and the
  loader compiler are our own.
